lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhau kaat keee niravaire jeeu ||
lines.translation: Dispelling my doubts and fears, the Guru has rid me of hatred.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur man kee aas pooraaee jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: The Guru has fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin naau paaiaa so dhanava(n)taa jeeu ||
lines.translation: One who has obtained the Name is wealthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin prabh dhiaaiaa s sobhaava(n)taa jeeu ||
lines.translation: One who meditates on God is glorified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis saadhoo sa(n)gat tis sabh sukaranee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Sublime are all the actions of those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੬੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sahaj samaaee jeeu ||5||1||166||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||5||1||166||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਝ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 maajh ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਹਮਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau hamaarai raam piaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: Come to me, O my Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain dinas saas saas chitaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: Night and day, with each and every breath, I think of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t deu sa(n)desaa pai charanaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: O Saints, give Him this message; I fall at Your Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tudh bin kit bidh tareeai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Without You, how can I be saved? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g tumaarai mai kare ana(n)daa jeeu ||
lines.translation: In Your Company, I am in ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: van tin tribhavan sukh paramaana(n)daa jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the forest, the fields and the three worlds, there is peace and supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej suhaavee ihu man bigasa(n)daa jeeu ||
lines.translation: My bed is beautiful, and my mind blossoms forth in ecstasy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pekh darasan ihu sukh laheeai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I have found this peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan pakhaar karee nit sevaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: I wash Your Feet, and constantly serve You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਦਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa arachaa ba(n)dan devaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: O Divine Lord, I worship and adore You; I bow down before You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: daasan daas naam jap levaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: I am the slave of Your slaves; I chant Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binau thaakur pahi kaheeai jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: I offer this prayer to my Lord and Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ichh pu(n)nee meree man tan hariaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: My desires are fulfilled, and my mind and body are rejuvenated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan pekhat sabh dukh parahariaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all my pains have been taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam jape jap tariaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੭॥
lines.transliteration: ihu ajar naanak sukh saheeai jeeu ||4||2||167||
lines.translation: Nanak endures this unendurable celestial bliss. ||4||2||167||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun saajan man mit piaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: Listen, listen, O my friend and companion, O Beloved of my mind:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਿ ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan teraa ihu jeeu bh vaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: my mind and body are Yours. This life is a sacrifice to You as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: visar naahee prabh praan adhaare jeeu ||
lines.translation: May I never forget God, the Support of the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa teree saranaaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: I have come to Your Eternal Sanctuary. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis miliai man jeevai bhaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Meeting Him, my mind is revived, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee so har har paaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I have found the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh prabh kaa prabh keeaa jaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: All things belong to God; all places belong to God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: prabh kau sad bal jaaee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu nidhaan japai vadabhaagee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate are those who meditate on this treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nira(n)jan ek liv laagee jeeu ||
lines.translation: They enshrine love for the Naam, the Name of the One Immaculate Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa paaiaa sabh dukh mitaaiaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Finding the Perfect Guru, all suffering is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar gun gaaiaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glories of God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan padaarath har naam tumaaraa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the treasure of jewels, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sachaa saahu bhagat vanajaaraa jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are the True Banker; Your devotee is the trader.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan raas sach vaapaaraa jeeu ||
lines.translation: True is the trade of those who have the wealth of the Lord's assets.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੮॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak sad balihaaraa jeeu ||4||3||168||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice. ||4||3||168||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa bahu maan karate too(n) meraa bahu maan ||
lines.translation: I am so proud of You, O Creator; I am so proud of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jor tumaarai sukh vasaa sach sabad neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Through Your Almighty Power, I dwell in peace. The True Word of the Shabad is my banner and insignia. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਜਾਤੀਆ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਚੁਪ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe galaa jaateeaa sun kai chup keeaa ||
lines.translation: He hears and knows everything, but he keeps silent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਲਧੀਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kad hee surat na ladheeaa maaiaa mohaRiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Bewitched by Maya, he never regains awareness. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਰਤ ਸਾਰਤਾ ਸੇ ਅਖੀ ਡਿਠੜਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dei bujhaarat saarataa se akhee dithaRiaa ||
lines.translation: The riddles and hints are given, and he sees them with his eyes.
